title: Create a shell alias for a command
summary: Create a shortcut name for a long or complex command. The alias works immediately in the current terminal window but disappears when you close it unless you add it to your shell configuration file.

steps.explain: Define a new alias by assigning a command string to a word. Replace <WORD> with your shortcut name and <COMMAND> with the command you want to run.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command string the alias will execute

steps.expect: No output is displayed if the alias is created successfully.
